narrative: On the board. The queen's line, and bare paper under the last sentence. The light has moved on the desk. Nothing new is written. On the board. At the left of the leaf, the older sheets, edges only. No number on the top edge. His hand is not on them. On the board. The verse and the question are both still as written. The pen has not come out of the rest.
